name: Electric space heater plan mark
summary: Plan mark for a fixed electric space heater, drawn as a rectangle with internal heating strokes.
description: Fixed space heaters such as panel heaters, convector heaters and radiant wall heaters are drawn as a rectangle at the wall with parallel strokes or a zigzag representing the heating element. The rating in watts or kilowatts is usually written beside the symbol.

The mark tells the electrician to provide a dedicated circuit or fused connection and a control, which may be an integral thermostat or a room thermostat shown separately. Heater ratings feed the maximum demand calculation. The heating element symbol on schematics shows the resistor function; this plan mark locates a complete appliance.
readingNotes: Check how the heater is controlled.
distinction: A heating element in a schematic is a component; this plan mark represents an installed heater appliance.
